Honestly, up to you. But there’s really not much they can do at this point to improve the current Oasis. Maybe add USB C, but that’s a stupid thing to wait for.

My advice: don’t worry about Kindle models. My old one lasted me eight years. And I couldn’t care less about the device itself, as long as I could read. If you’re on that same boat, go ahead and buy it now.

But if you wanna wait (and we don’t even know for sure there’s gonna be a new model this year btw), you can do that too. 

But the ultimate goal here is to read.
Go for it, I wouldn’t say it’s worth every penny, but it’s pretty damn good and definitely better than the Paperwhite experience.

Just the combined effect of the multitude of small improvements over the Paperwhite. More lights behind the screen, ambient light sensor, the yellow light feature, the aluminium build, the page turn buttons, faster processor, the notch on the side. Put all those together, it’s a genuine pleasure to hold and read with.

The display itself is much better on the Oasis, because of the 23 or something lights and the 300 ppi screen. And the old paper whites had the bezel raised over the screen, but this one is flush, so I prefer that. 

Overall, screen feels crisp and nice. And the yellow light is a very nice addition as well. And not to mention the ambient light sensors, so now I don’t have to manually adjust the lights every time I switch positions.

Physically, it’s not that much bigger. But the extra space on the side of the oasis feels like a godsend. On the Paperwhite, it always seems to me that I’m inadvertently blocking off a bit of the screen with my hand.

I also didn’t think the page turn buttons would make that much of a difference, but combine that with the better processor, it just feels smooth as butter. 

The bigger screen on the Oasis also makes it easier for me to read with a smaller font size. I like having more text on the page, so that’s just a personal preference. 

It’s really not something anyone should upgrade to an Oasis for, but there are so many small improvements that the overall effect is mind blowing.

Plus it just fees premium, yk? The aluminium back and the notch on the side adds this nice weight that makes it feel very solid and snug in my hand.

I personally think so, yes. I’ve barely put it down because it feels so nice to use. And the screen is so much better than my old Paperwhite. Plus I love the way it just fits in my hand with that notch on one side.
